points.label: The Market Street arch: a striped arch at the bottom of the hill, the busiest way in (a way in and out)
The Harbour Steps: a stone stair from the food yard down to the harbour road (a way in and out)
Cooper's Lane: a narrow back alley behind the chip shop (a way in and out)
Through the market hall to Bell Street, by the side doors (a way in and out)
St Bride's steps: Grace's broadcast desk, with speakers playing her show to the whole market
St Bride's market hall: the covered hall with its iron roof, full of stalls, with side doors onto Bell Street
The lanes of stalls: food, records, second-hand clothes and fortune-tellers, under strings of fairy lights
The food yard: long tables, a small stage and the salt-fish stall
The salt-fish stall, with its salt bins
The chip shop on Cooper's Lane (Bea Santos lives in the flat above)
The crowd in front of St Bride's steps
